methodology.description: Public draft-helper PPR redraft board. Player value and market cost are intentionally kept separate. Rankings blend broad expert consensus, current projections, recent independent expert boards and material preseason/news context; ADP is treated as price rather than player quality. League scoring, roster construction, draft slot, drafted players, positional scarcity and next-pick pressure are applied by the client recommendation engine.
rankingInputs: FantasyPros 2026 PPR expert consensus and player-specific ECR/ADP pages checked Aug. 26
ESPN 2026 Fantasy Football Marathon 10-team PPR mock published Aug. 26 plus Field Yates/Mike Clay preseason rankings
CBS Sports consensus Top 200 and SportsLine breakout/bust model updates through Aug. 25
RotoWire multi-analyst PPR board updated Aug. 26
NFL.com, ESPN, team-source and local beat reporting for late-August injury/depth-chart developments
FantasyPros consensus projections and current aggregated PPR ADP
methodology.marketInput: Current FantasyPros aggregated PPR ADP remains the primary market-price input, cross-checked against CBS, ESPN and RotoWire. ADP is a price signal, not a substitute for player value. Ashton Jeanty's injury has now moved his PPR market price to roughly No. 14 overall, while Omarion Hampton is around No. 18 and Kenneth Walker III around No. 19.
newsInputs: Ashton Jeanty's injury discount is reduced from the Aug. 25 board. Raiders coach Klint Kubiak said Jeanty is 'on the mend,' and follow-up reporting characterizes the injury as a low/mild ankle sprain rather than a long-term injury. Week 1 remains uncertain, so the public board still ranks him below his current market and expert median rather than treating the scare as fully resolved.

Omarion Hampton receives a material value upgrade. RotoWire's Aug. 26 PPR board ranks him 14th overall, ESPN's Aug. 26 expert mock selected him 17th, FantasyPros lists him as RB10 by ECR with a current PPR ADP around 18, and SportsLine's Aug. 25 model independently identified him as a breakout candidate.

Kenneth Walker III receives a material value upgrade despite a minor foot scare. He missed Tuesday practice, but subsequent reporting described him as fine. FantasyPros lists him RB9 by ECR, RotoWire ranks him 17th overall, and ESPN's Aug. 26 expert mock selected him 11th. His prior public-board rank of 27 had become too conservative relative to role, efficiency and current expert evidence.

Malik Nabers remains in the mid-20s rather than being aggressively upgraded. The Week 1 recovery trend is positive and ESPN's Aug. 26 mock took him 22nd, but SportsLine remains notably bearish on his season-long value, preserving a wide downside range.
No new suspension or trade involving another top-30 player was found that justified a larger value move in this refresh.
methodology.notes: Expert disagreement is preserved with expertLow/expertHigh ranges; unresolved injuries and genuine model disagreement can intentionally widen those ranges. Confidence reflects agreement plus news certainty, not ceiling. The Aug. 26 refresh reverses part of the emergency Ashton Jeanty injury discount, upgrades Omarion Hampton and materially corrects Kenneth Walker III upward after broader expert/usage evidence made the prior rank too low. Market/ADP changes are updated separately from player value. This file is used only by smhillis/sleeper-draft-helper-public and must not be copied into or used to modify Scott's personal Sleeper Draft Assistant.

players.name: James Cook III
players.news: Strong human-expert support remains in place and ESPN's Aug. 26 mock took him seventh overall, but SportsLine's current model is a meaningful bearish outlier and ranks him closer to a late-second/third-round RB value.

players.name: Christian McCaffrey
players.news: Returned to practice Aug. 23 after nearly three weeks sidelined by generalized tightness. Week 1 remains the target; injury risk is reduced, not erased.

players.name: Chris Olave
players.news: Jordyn Tyson's hamstring issue improves Olave's already strong target-volume outlook.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.news: NFL closed its investigation with no additional discipline. Knee recovery remains the main risk, materially reducing the prior suspension discount.

players.name: Omarion Hampton
players.news: Upgraded after converging evidence: RotoWire PPR rank 14 on Aug. 26, ESPN expert mock pick 17, FantasyPros RB10 ECR and SportsLine breakout support. Current PPR ADP around 18 is now broadly aligned with the public-board value rather than materially ahead of it.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.news: Moved sharply up from 27. FantasyPros has Walker RB9 by ECR, RotoWire ranks him 17th overall, and ESPN's Aug. 26 expert mock took him 11th. He missed Tuesday practice with a foot issue, but follow-up reporting described him as fine, so the injury widens the range rather than erasing the role/efficiency case.

players.name: Ashton Jeanty
players.news: Moved back up from 30 after the injury outlook improved. Kubiak says Jeanty is 'on the mend' and reports characterize the injury as a low/mild ankle sprain. FantasyPros still has him RB12 by ECR, RotoWire 19th overall, and ESPN's Aug. 26 expert mock took him 13th. Week 1 uncertainty still warrants a clear discount from market price.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.news: Shed the red non-contact jersey Aug. 24 and is trending toward Week 1. ESPN's Aug. 26 expert mock selected him 22nd, while SportsLine remains materially bearish, so the public board stays near the middle with a wide downside range.
